Mapping/labels: https://www.inegi.org.mx/contenidos/programas/ensu/datosabiertos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_2025_1t_csv.zip (sha256 e6287ebe0d900118053909a48bd365c4064aa92a930a9c4278526371396b6686, cached by the batch_689 round, hash re-checked), conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325/diccionario_de_datos/diccionario_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325.csv (variable labels, sha256 02520d1464b09609fff684a989ba1af029573dfdf939190b1a83a7eddf83702f), catalogos/bp3_*.csv (value labels) and conjunto_de_datos/conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325.csv (raw data, sha256 fe9f1dacf22bb3131096a67e1355fccbf39fd64222ce0c98e414e76bffd37b7b). note: Codes: data/mexico_2025_safety.do (Bookmark #3, Q1 2025 Government Performance) keeps INEGI columns bp3_1_01..bp3_1_16, bp3_1_99, bp3_2, bp3_2a from conjunto_de_datos_ensu_cb_0325.csv (import delimited case(lower)) and reshapes long with item = column name (core model s3 pattern 1, no positional step); recodes bp3_2 9 -> missing and bp3_2a 9 -> missing; id = row number within the 2025 Q1 subset. mapping_basis=data_labels: INEGI's 2025 Q1 data dictionary labels each BP3_* column (e.g. BP3_1_02 'Problemas que enfrenta la ciudad: Deficiencias en la red publica de drenaje'; BP3_1_16 '...: Ninguno'; BP3_2 'Efectividad del gobierno de su ciudad para resolver problemas'; BP3_2A 'Conocimiento del gobierno ha implementado actividades o programas para prevenir la violencia y/o la delincuencia'); 19/19 agree in content with the 2025 Q1 questionnaire item carrying the same code number (3.1 options 01-16, 99; 3.2; 3.2a). 2025 Q1 shape (checked in print, dictionary, raw CSV and .do, not assumed): Q1/Q3 shape, NOT the Q2/Q4 shape -- the 2025 Q1 print ends Section III at 3.2a on p.5 and goes straight to Seccion IV. Confianza en los niveles de gobierno (no CP3 servidor-publico definition, no 3.3-3.6); the 0325 dictionary, catalogos and raw CSV carry only the 19 BP3_1_*/BP3_2/BP3_2A columns; the .do bookmark keeps the same 19. 2025 Q1 vs 2024 Q4 / Q3 wording: a normalised text-layer diff of Section III against the 2024 Q3 print differs only in layout order, line wraps and footer; all 26 distinct Spanish strings shipped by batch_681 (3.1 stem, 17 options, 3.2 and 3.2a stems, 4+2 printed options) are found in the 2025 Q1 text layer (pp.4-5) after whitespace/dot-leader normalisation. Against 2024 Q4 (batch_686) the only differences are the dropped corruption block and nothing else: 3.1 options, 3.2, 3.2a identical, option 12 printed 'fraudes, etcetera)' with no period in both (confirmed on a 200-dpi render of p.4). Dictionary vs 2024 Q3: BP3_1_12 label now 'etcetera)' (Q3 said 'etc.)') and BP3_1_99 'No sabe/no responde' (Q3 'No sabe/ no responde'); all 19 catalogos/bp3_*.csv byte-identical to 2024 Q3's. Cross-check (route 9 style): all 40 live item x level counts (queried server-side, no export) equal the raw INEGI 2025 Q1 CSV after the .do's recodes, 40/40 (e.g. bp3_1_01 0/1 = 8952/14639, bp3_1_16 0/1 = 23263/328, bp3_1_99 0/1 = 23572/19, bp3_2 1/2/3/4 = 935/6571/10117/5499, bp3_2a 1/2 = 7831/15083); raw 23591 rows = 23591 live ids, 447083 live rows. Code 9 set missing by the .do: bp3_2 122, bp3_2a 677. Routing (not a defect): bp3_2 blank in raw for 347 = 328 (bp3_1_16 Ninguno) + 19 (bp3_1_99), exactly the respondents with either code, matching the printed skip 'SI SE REGISTRO CODIGO 16 ... O 99 ..., PASE A 3.2a'. Words: item_text / section_prompt are the administered 2025 Q1 questionnaire wording (text_source=study_materials). Kept as printed: '(CIUDAD)' fill, 'etcetera)' in 12. Normalised: line wraps joined with a space; the visible double space in option 06 'limpia y  recoleccion' collapsed. Stripped: question numbers, option codes, dot leaders, 'ESPECIFIQUE' blank after Otro, interviewer directions (MUESTRE LA TARJETA 'C'; CIRCULE LOS CODIGOS CORRESPONDIENTES / UN SOLO CODIGO; the 3.1 skip instruction). Tarjeta C is not in the questionnaire zip and was not transcribed. Structure (same as batch_673/681): section _1 = 3.1 (stem in section_prompt, option wording in item_text), _2 = 3.2, _3 = 3.2a (stems in item_text); instructions blank -- Section III has no read-aloud introduction in Q1. Options: bp3_1_* are 0/1 flags for a circled code; option_text is INEGI's catalogo label ('0' = 'No se declaro como opcion afirmativa', '1' = 'Si', identical in all 17 catalogos), not questionnaire print. bp3_2 1-4 = Muy/Algo/Poco/Nada efectivo and bp3_2a 1/2 = Si/No are printed and identical in the catalogos; code 9 'No sabe / no responde' has no row (set missing by the .do). Every level each item's respondents used has an option row (40/40 live item x resp cells). Step 3b: live items match this question block exactly (19 = 17 + 1 + 1); dictionary Description ('Resident evaluations of local and federal government security performance, Q1 2025') overstates it -- 3.1 is a city-problems checklist and 3.2/3.2a ask only about the (CIUDAD) government; the dictionary Reference names 'ENSU 2023' while data and wording are the 2025 Q1 wave (file suffix 0325) -- same defect as the siblings. INEGI-side cosmetic label defect, no effect on shipped text: BP3_1_09 label has a double space after the colon; 0325 dictionary PER range reads '0125'. English in _translated is this project's own translation (machine_translation), reused verbatim from batch_681 (2024 Q3; itself reused from batch_673, 2024 Q1) for every field -- the Spanish is identical string for string; nothing translated fresh. INEGI publishes no English questionnaire.
public_note: Fuente: INEGI, Encuesta Nacional de Seguridad Pública Urbana (ENSU) 2025, primer trimestre -- IRW transcribed Section III (questions 3.1-3.2a) from INEGI's questionnaire, stripped interviewer directions, used INEGI's data-catalogue labels for the 0/1 checklist codes, and added an English translation of its own; INEGI does not endorse this item text.
